meta.name: frame-macos-notification
meta.description: 拟真 macOS 通知 banner + app icon + 标题正文, 适合 video overlay / 产品发布预告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成拟真 macOS 通知横幅，用于视频叠加或产品预告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或演示中模拟 macOS 系统通知效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic macOS notification banners for video overlays or product teasers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate macOS notification banners in videos or demos

howto.what: 把用户给的公告或消息渲染成 macOS Big Sur 风格通知横幅:单个 HTML 文件,含磨砂玻璃背景、App 图标、标题和正文,可作视频右上角叠加或 480×120 的独立 banner。
howto.when: 当你要求做 macOS 风格通知横幅、视频角落叠加,或把公告/消息包装成产品发布预告时触发;内容必须由你提供标题和正文。

say.text: 做一个 macOS 通知横幅,标题“新版本发布”,正文“实时协作已上线”
say.note: 生成含图标和正文的横幅 HTML

say.text: 把这段公告渲染成 Big Sur 磨砂玻璃通知,放视频右上角
用 App 名“Clipboard”和消息“已复制 3 项”做通知 banner
say.note: App 图标用 unicode emoji 绘制

howto.what_en: Renders the user's announcement/message into a macOS Big Sur-style notification banner: one HTML file with frosted-glass background, app icon, title and body; works as video top-right overlay or 480×120 standalone banner.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a macOS notification banner, video overlay, or a product-launch teaser; title and body must come from your input.

say_en.text: Make a macOS notification banner: title ‘New release’, body ‘Real-time collaboration is live’.
say_en.note: Generates banner HTML with icon and body.

say_en.text: Render this announcement as a Big Sur frosted-glass notification for the video top-right.
Use app name ‘Clipboard’ and message ‘Copied 3 items’ for a notification banner.
say_en.note: App icon drawn with a unicode emoji.
